subject: MAP: Data governance & security gates — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention windows
messages:
From: Alice Torres <alice.torres@novabank.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NovaBank Security Team <security@novabank.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP request — security gating & retention windows

Maya / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, Security and Legal need a mutual action plan that enumerates the compliance gates for our evaluation and procurement cadence. To help us scope the PoC and procurement timeline, we need explicit commitments on the following items:

- SOC 2: expected evidence window and target report date; any reliance on third-party attestations.
- SIG/CAIQ: level of completion you can commit to for our eval (self-assessment + evidence attachments).
- DPA: proposed redline areas (data residency, subprocessors, breach notification timeline).
- Data retention: retention options (default, max, purge controls) and any syslog/trace retention for audit.

I attached our initial SIG checklist (novabank_SIG_initial.xlsx) — it maps items we must validate during the PoC. Can you produce a draft MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria by EOD Wednesday (05/19)? Our procurement target is to reach legal signoff by 06/15.

Regards,
Alice Torres
Head of Platform Risk, NovaBank

[Attachment: novabank_SIG_initial.xlsx]
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Torres <alice.torres@novabank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request — security gating & retention windows

Alice — thanks for the clear list and the SIG workbook. Attaching a first-pass MAP (redwood_MAP_v1.docx) that breaks down the timeline and gate responsibilities. Highlights:

- PoC kickoff: 05/24 — 2 weeks of functional testing (connectivity, inference parity, latency SLAs).
- Security & evidence sprint: 06/07–06/11 — our team will upload SOC 2 SOC1 scopes and SIG artifacts to a shared Drive folder; we will partner with your security SME for evidence intake.
- Legal & DPA cycle: draft redlines provided by our counsel by 05/21; expect 2 full review cycles before 06/10.
- Data retention: default 90 days for non-production logs, option for 30/90/365 configurable windows for inference content; long-term archival only by contract with encrypted storage.

Acceptance criteria (short):
1) SOC 2: provide copy of latest report + SOC 2 controls matrix for items relevant to NovaBank (encryption, access controls, incident response).
2) SIG: complete CAIQ self-assessment + evidence links (config screenshots, policy PDFs).
3) DPA: agreement on subprocessors list + breach notification within 72 hours.

Next step: Laura, can you drop the DPA redlines into the same Drive folder by EOD tomorrow? Sean — can you confirm what SOC 2 evidence we can provide during the PoC (scoped snippets vs. full report)?

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_MAP_v1.docx]
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Torres <alice.torres@novabank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: DPA redlines and retention clarifications

Maya / Alice — I reviewed NovaBank's standard DPA clauses and inserted a set of proposed redlines. Key points:

- Data residency: Redwood can commit to region-specific hosting (us-west-2) for production scope under Dedicated or Private deployment; Hosted API will require contract language limiting EU/other transfers unless otherwise requested.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a limited list; we will provide a detailed subprocessors appendix and support customer audits under NDA.
- Retention & deletion: propose default "30/90/365" token content retention tiers; for regulated customers we can add contractual purge-on-demand within 24 hours of request (subject to agreed interfaces).
- Breach notification: 72-hour initial notice, 30-day full remediation report.

Attached: DPA_redlines_LB.pdf (high level notes inline). I've also added a short checklist of the legal items that would move the deal to procurement (signature of DPA + evidence of SOC 2 controls).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: DPA_redlines_LB.pdf]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Torres <alice.torres@novabank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Evaluation plan (evidence intake & SOC 2 scope)

Maya / Alice — following up with the evaluation runbook. Summary:

- Evidence intake: we will push an evidence bundle to the shared Drive on 06/07. Bundle contents: SOC 2 report (redacted where required), controls matrix mapping to SIG/CAIQ, configuration screenshots for encryption at rest/in transit, IAM policies, audit log retention doc.
- SOC 2 scope: Redwood's current Type II report covers our inference runtime, orchestration, and ops controls. For NovaBank-specific concerns (data segregation in multi-tenant hosted), we will provide additional control narratives and design diagrams.
- Acceptance criteria for PoC: 1) successful sample ingest & inference with configured retention = 30 days; 2) performance within 120ms p95 on test workload; 3) SIG items flagged as 'high' resolved or mitigated (workarounds documented).

I also included a short escalation path: if any high-risk SIG item is identified, we will pause procurement and schedule a remediation plan with weekly checkpoints until closed.

On the attachments: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II by NDAs; full report release requires an executed NDA/POC order.

- Sean
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Torres <alice.torres@novabank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final MAP commitments & next steps — NovaBank PoC timeline (confirmed)

Alice — thanks to you and your team for the clear priorities. Per our internal alignment above, final commitments:

- MAP timeline: kickoff 05/24; evidence sprint 06/07–06/11; legal DPA cycles complete by 06/10; target procurement signature 06/15.
- Evidence: we will upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II and controls matrix to the Drive folder on 06/07 pending your NDA. SIG workbook: we will prepopulate ~70% of CAIQ items and tag the remaining items requiring customer-specific evidence.
- Retention: default platform retention = 90 days for inference content; for NovaBank we will enable 30-day retention option for PoC and include contractual purge-on-demand within 24 hours for production contract.
- DPA: Laura will circulate the redline PDF (attached). Please confirm the subprocessors list you require and whether you need Dedicated/Private deployment for the production window.

Action items:
1) Alice: confirm NDA/POC order by 05/21 so we can push the SOC 2 bundle on 06/07.
2) NovaBank security: review the attached MAP and SIG pre-fill; call scheduled for 05/25 10:00 PT to walk through evidence intake.
3) Laura: finalize DPA language for procurement submission by 05/21.

I'll update the Drive with the MAP (final) and link into HubSpot: 00481234. Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this cleanly.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_MAP_v1.docx, DPA_redlines_LB.pdf]
